about: Reaching Social Security by phone or in person.

rows.plain: Social Security's national number is 1-800-772-1213 (TTY 1-800-325-0778), Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time. Automated services work 24 hours a day.
Social Security says wait times tend to be shorter early in the morning, later in the week and later in the month.
When offered, you can choose a callback instead of holding. Keep your phone near you and answer calls from unknown numbers.
You can call or visit your local office. Most in-person services need an appointment; ask for one by phone.
Social Security publishes its current phone and office wait times.
